name: programs
description: The draft programming of one source: exactly one group or one screen.
lifecycle: A group's program is created with the group and deleted with it (cascade inside the module); a screen's program is created when its first output is saved and kept with the device record. Saving an output bumps the version.

columns.Meaning: Company that owns the program; immutable (tenant key).

columns.Null meaning: The program belongs to a screen.
The program belongs to a group.

columns.Meaning: Optimistic concurrency version, starting at 1; the API reports 0 for a program not yet saved.
PostgreSQL-clock instant of the last change.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, device_id) REFERENCES devices(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The screen belongs to the same company.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id) REFERENCES companies(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: A program belongs to an existing company.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, group_id) REFERENCES programming_groups(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE CASCADE
constraints.Purpose: The group belongs to the same company; its program is deleted with it.
A program belongs to exactly one group or one screen.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX programs_company_id_id_key ON public.programs USING btree (company_id, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX programs_device_key ON public.programs USING btree (company_id, device_id)
constraints.Purpose: A screen has at most one program.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX programs_group_key ON public.programs USING btree (company_id, group_id)
constraints.Purpose: A group has at most one program.
